description: This file is a shell script for testing a 'post-rewrite' hook in git. It includes setting up test commits, executing hook setups, and verifying hook inputs through various git commands like commit amend, rebase, and interactive rebase. The script is part of test suite to ensure correct behavior of hooks within a git project.

methods.name: clear_hook_input
methods.description: Removes hook input files to reset environment before tests.

methods.name: verify_hook_input
methods.description: Verifies that the hook input files contain expected data.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Configures a fake editor for testing interactive commands.

methods.name: test_fail_interactive_rebase
methods.description: Tests rebase interaction with a specified fake editor input sequence, expecting failure.
